title: Log RewardMilestoneService.getAllMilestones/getAllUnlocks JSON-decode failures instead of silently returning an empty list that can later overwrite cloud data
rule: EH-3 (log-less catch is a pending violation; every catch rethrows, converts, or logs via AppLogger)
why: If the SharedPreferences-stored reward config JSON is unreadable (process death mid-write, storage corruption, cross-version format mismatch), getAllMilestones/getAllUnlocks silently treat 'corrupt' the same as 'genuinely empty', with zero AppLogger call. That empty result then flows straight into exportCloudPayload(), which is what pushGamificationSettingsSnapshot() uploads as the authoritative reward_settings snapshot on the next sync -- silently overwriting the family's real, previously-configured reward list on every other synced device, with no diagnostic trail to explain why rewards 'disappeared'. The existing test suite (reward_milestone_service_test.dart 'getAllMilestones edge cases', lines 536-574) exercises invalid/blank/non-list JSON but only ever asserts the method returns empty -- it pins the silent-swallow as the specified behavior rather than testing that the failure is surfaced or logged.
recommendation: Log via AppLogger.error (or similar) inside both catch blocks before returning the fallback list, including enough context (profileId, key) to diagnose; consider whether a corrupt-vs-genuinely-empty distinction should block the next cloud push instead of silently exporting empty.
acceptance_criteria: Both catch(_) blocks in getAllMilestones/getAllUnlocks call AppLogger before returning the empty fallback
A test seeds corrupted JSON, calls the method, and asserts the logger recorded the failure (fake/spy AppLogger sink)
